n587552562.description: Basic bush campground at 645 Ennis Road in Tallarook State Forest for fully self-sufficient campers. No facilities or bins; access can be limited and a 4WD is recommended.

w1066498823.description: Committee-run lakeside camping in Green Lake Regional Park, 10 km from Sea Lake, with powered and unpowered sites, hot showers, toilets, laundry, BBQs and boat ramp. First in, no bookings for sites. No drinking water; nearest dump point is in Sea Lake.

n1808392094.name: Rye East Foreshore Camping
n1808392094.description: Shire-run seasonal foreshore camping on Crown land between the road and the bay at Rye (east section). Powered and unpowered sites of irregular size, shared taps, toilets, showers and laundry. Open late October to late April only.

n2005986046.name: Rye West Foreshore Camping
n2005986046.description: Western section of the Shire-run Rye foreshore campground, towards the old lime kiln. Seasonal (late October to late April), bookings through the Shire; powered and unpowered sites with toilets, showers and laundry.

n1808392120.name: Sorrento Foreshore Reserve
n1808392120.description: One of the three foreshore campgrounds run by Mornington Peninsula Shire. Seasonal camping (roughly late October to late April) booked through the Shire.

n1808394519.name: Rosebud Foreshore Reserve
n1808394519.reason: Duplicate of the Rosebud Foreshore section records already enriched (w481970530 etc.)

n1808394541.name: Shoreham Foreshore Reserve
n1808394541.operator: Shoreham Foreshore Reserve Committee of Management
n1808394541.description: Foreshore camping reserve at Shoreham run by its own Crown land committee of management, not the Shire. Check with the committee for season, fees and bookings.

n2005986044.name: Whitecliffs Foreshore Reserve
n2005986044.operator: Whitecliffs to Camerons Bight Foreshore Reserve Committee of Management Inc
n2005986044.description: Foreshore camping between Whitecliffs and Camerons Bight near Rye, run by a Crown land committee of management. Contact the committee for season and bookings.

n863349374.name: Wye River Beachfront Campground
n863349374.operator: Great Ocean Road Coast and Parks Authority
n863349374.description: Public-authority campground right on the beach at Wye River, mostly powered sites plus a few unpowered. Camp kitchen, laundry, accessible amenities and BBQs; store, cafe and pub across the road. Dogs allowed on set sites outside peak times.

n2005938578.name: Apollo Bay Recreation Reserve
n2005938578.operator: Great Ocean Road Coast and Parks Authority
n2005938578.description: Public-authority camping reserve beside the Barham River, under 1 km from Apollo Bay town centre, with powered and unpowered sites and dog-friendly sites.

n4583519690.name: Port Campbell Recreation Reserve
n4583519690.operator: Great Ocean Road Coast and Parks Authority
n4583519690.description: Public-authority camping reserve in Port Campbell, a dog-friendly base for the Twelve Apostles and Loch Ard Gorge.

n1808393821.name: Ludlows Reserve
n1808393821.description: Wodonga Council overnight stop on a big grassy area near Lake Hume at Ebden, on the High Country Rail Trail. Toilets, picnic table, BBQ and a boat ramp; big rigs and pets OK. 24 hours only, caravans and motorhomes only (no tents or camper trailers).

w487256782.name: Aysons Reserve
w487256782.reason: Duplicate of n1808392599 Aysons Reserve (Campaspe River), already enriched

n1808391906.name: Katamatite Lions Memorial Park
n1808391906.description: Small memorial park on the Benalla-Tocumwal Road in Katamatite. Moira Shire lists potable water taps in Katamatite but does NOT include this park on its RV overnight list, so overnight stays are unconfirmed.

w1194880396.name: Greens Lake Camping Area
w1194880396.description: Free camping on the western foreshore of Greens Lake near Corop, above the full-supply line, for up to seven days in a row. Toilet and shower block, BBQ area and boat ramp; carry your rubbish out. Campaspe Shire lists a dump point here.

n1808391850.name: Girgarre Town Park
n1808391850.description: Town campground on Morgan Crescent, Girgarre, listed by Campaspe Shire with a dump point. Community pages describe donation-based RV camping with toilets and hot showers, a 4-day limit and no camping on market Sundays (unconfirmed by council).

n1808392757.name: Cowwarr Weir
n1808392757.reason: Southern Rural Water: not a designated camping area; reserve open 8am-8pm, overnight camping prohibited

n1808391812.name: Donald Apex Park (Stuart Adams River Reserve)
n1808391812.description: Free campground in Donald listed on Buloke Shire's tourism site, with toilets, a dump point and BBQs. Dog friendly; no tents and no fires. OSM point "Donald Town Park" assumed to be this site (2 Aitkin Ave), check location.

n1808391876.name: Hopetoun Caravan Park
n1808391876.description: Yarriambiack Shire caravan park on Austin Street, a short walk from Lakes Lascelles and Corrong. Powered and unpowered sites, cabins, amenities, BBQs and a rubbish point; book and pay online.

n1808392140.name: Taradale Mineral Springs Reserve
n1808392140.description: Mount Alexander Shire lists this as a park and hireable venue (BBQ, toilets, playground), with no mention of camping. Treat overnight stays as unconfirmed.
n1808392140.source_url2: https://spatial.infrastructure.gov.au/server/rest/services/Hosted/RADAR_Curated_Prod_restareas/FeatureServer/1 (National Formal Rest Area dataset, VIC state data)

n4010648828.name: Hamilton Showgrounds
n4010648828.description: Run by the Hamilton Pastoral & Agricultural Society. Camping only with prior written approval from the Society and Southern Grampians Shire, mainly for event participants; not a drop-in stop. Hamilton Caravan Park is across the road.
n4010648828.label: events / approval only

w239273884.name: Wangaratta Showgrounds
w239273884.description: Showground camping appears to be event-only (e.g. festival camping). Outside events, Rural City of Wangaratta requires a paid permit for camping on non-designated land. Call first.
w239273884.label: events / approval only

w137483219.name: Camperdown Showgrounds
w137483219.description: Society-run showgrounds used for events and community hire. Their hire agreement lists event camping only; no public RV stopover is advertised. Ask the society before turning up.
w137483219.label: events / approval only

w84150053.name: Whittlesea Showgrounds
w84150053.description: Council-owned showgrounds and recreation reserve. Camping is offered for specific events (powered and unpowered sites); no everyday travellers' stop is advertised. Call first.
w84150053.label: events / approval only

w1282082977.name: Sale Showground
w1282082977.reason: Duplicate of n1808394529 Sale Showground Caravan & Motorhome Park (already enriched)

w283066583.name: Tatura Park (Tatura Showgrounds)
w283066583.description: Council-run Tatura Park offers powered and unpowered camping by prior arrangement; may be unavailable during events. Council site could not be fetched (504), so details come from the council hire-charges listing via search.
w283066583.label: call first

new:tatura-rv-rest-stop.name: Tatura RV Rest Stop
new:tatura-rv-rest-stop.description: Free council RV rest stop in the Douglas Street car park, Tatura: three bays for fully self-contained vehicles, 48 hours max. No tents or fires; empty tanks only at proper dump points.

new:bealiba-reservoir.name: Bealiba Reservoir
new:bealiba-reservoir.description: Free first-come camping around Bealiba Reservoir off Scent Farm Road, for tents, caravans and RVs, away from the swimming and picnic area. Donations welcome; take rubbish home. Council has added signage to the camping spots.

n1808392109.name: Skinners Flat Reservoir
n1808392109.description: Free camping along the shore of Skinners Flat Reservoir near Wedderburn/Inglewood, with areas for RVs, caravans, camper trailers and tents. Drop toilet, sheltered picnic area, wood BBQs, fire pits and a boat ramp. Last 1 km is gravel.

n1808391934.name: Lake Charlegrark Caravan Park
n1808391934.description: Lakeside caravan park at 78 Lake Charlegrark Road near Minimay with powered and unpowered sites, cabins and pet-friendly grounds. Listed on the West Wimmera Shire tourism site; a paid park, not a free camp.

n1808393547.name: Kevington Hotel
n1808393547.description: Historic high-country pub on the Mansfield-Woods Point Road with about 15 riverside bush campsites on 3 acres beside the Goulburn River, on request. Low-cost; dogs on leads, fire pits only (none on Total Fire Ban days), limited rubbish facilities. Meals at the pub.

new:abbotsford-bend-camping-area-murray-.description: Riverside bush camp on the Murray managed by Parks Victoria, listed as a camping area on its River Murray Reserve pages. Expect no facilities; check access tracks after rain or high river levels.
new:abbotsford-bend-camping-area-murray-.source_note: Parks Victoria Murray River reach page (SA border to Piangil): all riverside campsites are free, no bookings required.

new:barmah-island-central-camping-area-m.description: Basic riverside bush camp on the Victorian bank of the Murray, managed by Parks Victoria. Free, first come, no bookings. Usually no facilities, so come self-sufficient; many river tracks need 4WD and close after rain or high water.

n8282192218.source_note: Parks Victoria lists The Glut (Mount Buangor National Park) as a picnic area for day visits; camping is not mentioned. Possible exclusion: check before keeping as a campsite.

n1808391811.name: Donald Lakeside Caravan Park
n1808391811.description: Lakeside caravan park at 2 Corack Road, Donald, with large sites and powered sites, on a Crown land reserve leased out by Buloke Shire Council. A paid caravan park, not a free camp.
n1808391811.ownership_note: Crown land reserve; Buloke Shire Council called for a long-term lease to develop and operate the Donald Caravan Park (tender C33 2015/16) and its Sept 2015 agenda refers to the park lessee. Current lessee not named in official sources.

n1808391958.name: Landsborough Caravan Park
n1808391958.description: Small caravan park on the main street of Landsborough, next to the summer pool, with powered and unpowered sites, a toilet block, laundry and playground. A paid caravan park; no pets.
n1808391958.ownership_note: Council-owned: Pyrenees Shire Council budget lists caravan parks as a council service and its Better Caravan Parks project upgraded Landsborough Caravan Park; the council playground page calls the site part of the caravan park. Day-to-day operating model (direct or managed) not stated.

n1808393379.name: Glenrowan Tourist Park
n1808393379.description: Tourist park at 2 Old Hume Highway, Glenrowan (listed in OpenStreetMap as Glenrowan Caravan Park), with cabins and caravan sites, toilets and hot showers, a camp kitchen, laundry, pool and a dump point. A paid park; book by phone or email.
n1808393379.reason: Privately owned: Glenrowan Tourist Park About page says the family purchased the park in February 2020. Out of scope under Nev rule.

w189986731.description: Holiday park at Jan Juc with cabins and powered and unpowered camping, toilets, hot showers, a pool and laundry. A paid park with a no-dogs policy.
w189986731.reason: Kept in on Nev decision 20 Oct 2026 (Crown reserve, operator not officially stated).

n1808392083.name: Riverbank Caravan Park, Nathalia
n1808392083.description: Privately owned caravan park on Broken Creek at 1-5 Park Street, Nathalia, with grassy powered sites (some ensuite) for caravans, motorhomes and tents, cabins, amenities, laundry and a dump point. A paid park.
n1808392083.reason: Privately owned caravan park (own site: "A privately owned caravan park on the banks of the Broken Creek"). Out of scope under Nev rule: private/commercial caravan parks excluded.

w280672060.name: Forrest Holiday Park
w280672060.description: Holiday park in Forrest in the Otways (formerly Forrest Caravan Park) with cabins and grassy powered and unpowered sites, amenities, barbecues and a camp kitchen. A paid park.
w280672060.operator: BelgraviaPro (lease from Colac Otway Shire Council)
w280672060.ownership_note: Council-owned; Colac Otway Shire granted BelgraviaPro a 15-year lease (plus 5-year option) and the park reopened as Forrest Holiday Park in June 2022. Council later upgraded the site wastewater system.

w1117308921.operator: Corinella Foreshore Reserve Committee of Management
w1117308921.description: Small family caravan park in a bush setting on the Corinella foreshore reserve at 3 Peters Street, run by the reserve committee of management, with powered and unpowered sites and cabins. A paid park; bookings online.
w1117308921.ownership_note: Crown land foreshore reserve; the caravan park is run directly by the Corinella Foreshore Reserve Committee of Management (DEECA-appointed). Not council, but public (Crown) ownership run by the land manager rather than leased to a business, so filed as council_park.

n12345755270.description: Unpowered camping on the oval and in treed areas of the Tolmie Recreation Reserve, for tents, camper trailers, caravans and big rigs. Showers and a camp kitchen; pay at the honesty box (cash); no bookings needed; campfires only in the fireplaces provided; take rubbish home; no dump point (nearest at Mansfield or Moyhu); stays up to 4 consecutive weeks a year.

n1808392205.description: Ararat Rural City Council describes the Willaura Recreation Reserve as having room to camp, with an outdoor pool in summer, tennis courts, a playground, shade trees and free barbecues. Other camping details are not published by the council.

n7650872876.description: Designated riverside camping area in Barmah National Park, managed by Parks Victoria. Free, no bookings, no dogs. Bring everything you need, including water and a portable toilet.

n1808392185.description: Bush camping along the creeks and river on Wallpolla Island in Murray-Sunset National Park. Free, no booking, first in first served; no designated sites or facilities. Access via the unsealed Old Mail Road: 2WD in dry weather only, 4WD recommended; gates close in floods.

n980292673.source_note: Location is on Lindsay Island in Murray-Sunset NP (matched by coordinates, not named on the page). The PV page says Lindsay Island bush camping is free, no booking, first in first served, no designated areas.
n980292673.description: Devils Elbow: bush camping on Lindsay Island in Murray-Sunset National Park, near the SA border. Free, no booking, no facilities. Unsealed access: 2WD in dry weather only, 4WD recommended; tracks close in floods.

n1676323193.source_note: Location is on Lindsay Island in Murray-Sunset NP (matched by coordinates, not named on the page). The PV page says Lindsay Island bush camping is free, no booking, first in first served, no designated areas.
n1676323193.description: Glassy Meadows: bush camping on Lindsay Island in Murray-Sunset National Park, near the SA border. Free, no booking, no facilities. Unsealed access: 2WD in dry weather only, 4WD recommended; tracks close in floods.

w1361004609.source_note: Location is on Lindsay Island in Murray-Sunset NP (matched by coordinates, not named on the page). The PV page says Lindsay Island bush camping is free, no booking, first in first served, no designated areas.
w1361004609.description: Lindsay Point Campground: bush camping on Lindsay Island in Murray-Sunset National Park, near the SA border. Free, no booking, no facilities. Unsealed access: 2WD in dry weather only, 4WD recommended; tracks close in floods.

n5235873634.description: Walk-in camping area at JB Plain in Alpine National Park, between Hotham Village and Dinner Plain off the Great Alpine Road. Toilets, picnic tables and fireplaces.

n316596701.description: Camping area with horse yards on the Bogong High Plains east of Falls Creek, Alpine National Park. Toilets, picnic tables and fireplaces; the yards can be booked through Parks Victoria (horse season 1 December to 30 April).

w743755133.description: Popular horse camp on the Bogong High Plains in Alpine National Park with campsites, fireplaces, basic toilets and Parks Victoria horse yards (bookable). No dispersed camping within 200 m of Pretty Valley Road.

n5235767464.description: Horse camp in the West Kiewa, Alpine National Park, with yards, campsites, fireplaces and basic toilets; low-elevation riding with access to the Bogong High Plains via Westons Spur.

n508105972.description: Camping area with facilities at Lake Cobbler in Alpine National Park (Wabonga Plateau / Mt Cobbler area). 4WD access recommended; the road is very rough for 2WD past Bennies.
n508105972.source_note: Location inside Alpine National Park per DataVic Public Land Management (PLM25) layer. Parks Victoria "Dispersed camping in Alpine National Park": bookings and fees apply only to the Falls to Hotham Alpine Crossing; campers must be fully self-sufficient with food and water. PV Howqua Hills camping page: dogs are not allowed in Alpine National Park.

w243116210.access_notes: walk-in only (6 km from car park)
w243116210.description: Hike-in camp in an open grassy area near the Bunyip River, Bunyip State Park, about 6 km walk from the car park off Bunyip River Road. Shared picnic table, no toilet.

n2707968028.description: One of five overnight hikers' campsites in the northern wilderness of Wilsons Promontory National Park. Campsite only, no facilities. Hikers need a permit (Hiker Self Assessment Form first) and must navigate with map and compass.

n2909005261.description: Yellow Gum Walkers Camp in Little Desert National Park, a walkers' camp with a toilet, fireplace and table. No drinking water; bring your own (limited non-potable tank water may be available).

n316599378.description: Campground on T & W Road in Cobboboonee National Park, near the Great South West Walk. Free to use and no booking needed.

w237352775.description: Slaty Creek No. 1, the largest of three small camping and picnic areas on Slaty Creek near Creswick, the only camping in Creswick Regional Park. Toilets, suits larger groups, dogs on lead, fires only in the steel fireplaces, carry out your rubbish.

Location inside Winton Wetlands reserve per DataVic PLM25 (committee of management). Greens Hill Camp ("beneath the Eagles Nest") is the likely match - check on the map.
w1196258392.description: Bush camping area inside Winton Wetlands near Benalla, run by the reserve's committee of management. Camping is free, first in first served, with no bookings. Bring your own water. No dogs at any Winton Wetlands camp. The reserve closes on Total Fire Ban days.

n11090763889.source_note: Winton Wetlands camping page: camping currently free, first in first served, no bookings; 20 unpowered campsites in three areas (Greens Hill Camp, Bill Friday Swamp, Duckpond Camp); bring your own water; dogs not allowed at any Winton Wetlands camp sites; fires only in official fireplaces; reserve closed on Total Fire Ban days. Location inside Winton Wetlands reserve per DataVic PLM25 (committee of management). OSM name "Wood Duck Camping Ground" (VicNames) does not match the website camp names; the point is in the north-east of the reserve, where the official map shows "Bush Camp @ Duck Pond" (open bush camping, no fire pit, picnic tables, tents; campervans/trailers with care). Reserve-wide facts only.
n11090763889.description: Basic bush camping area in the north of Winton Wetlands near Benalla (probably the Duck Pond bush camp). Free, first in first served, no bookings. Bring your own water. No dogs at any Winton Wetlands camp. The reserve closes on Total Fire Ban days.

w386169867.source_note: GORCAPA Allenvale Campground page (Parks Victoria URL now redirects there): 20 unpowered walk-in sites, tents only, about 230 m from the carpark; bookings and payment required year-round; non-flush toilets, low tables, shelters; no fireplaces and no fires; bring your own drinking water; take rubbish home. GORCAPA manages this part of Great Otway NP from 1 July 2025 (PV Lorne page; DataVic PLM25).
w386169867.description: Allenvale Campground beside the St George River just outside Lorne: 20 walk-in tent sites about 230 m from the carpark, with non-flush toilets, low tables and shelters. Book and pay ahead (all year). No fires, so bring a gas or fuel stove, and bring your own drinking water. Managed by the Great Ocean Road Coast and Parks Authority.
w386169867.operator: Great Ocean Road Coast and Parks Authority

n1187108930.access_notes: 2WD via Jamieson Track off the Great Ocean Road
n1187108930.source_note: GORCAPA Jamieson Creek Campground page (via the Parks Victoria URL): 24 unpowered sites; sites 10-19 walk-in tents only; sites 4 and 7 suit caravans; others tents, camper trailers and campervans; bookings and payment required year-round; non-flush toilets, shared fireplaces (BYO firewood); 2WD via Jamieson Track. Matched to this OSM "Jamieson Track Camping Area" by name and track. GORCAPA notes January 2026 flood damage and trail closures near Lorne and on Jamieson Track - check before going.
n1187108930.description: Jamieson Creek Campground on Jamieson Track between Lorne and Wye River: 24 unpowered sites, most for tents, camper trailers and campervans, two for caravans, plus walk-in tent sites. Non-flush toilets and shared fireplaces (bring firewood). Book and pay ahead (all year). 2WD access. Check for flood-recovery closures on Jamieson Track first.
n1187108930.operator: Great Ocean Road Coast and Parks Authority

w111295232.source_note: Park's own site: unpowered garden and riverfront camp sites (tents, swags), book online, no pets, no powered sites, wash-up sinks, kiosk, fire drums. DataVic PLM25: Cumberland River Coastal Camping Reserve, Crown land managed by GORCAPA. The park is not on GORCAPA's own parks list, so it appears to be run by an operator on the reserve; the lease/operator is not stated officially (flag for Nev, as with Jan Juc).
w111295232.description: Holiday park on the Cumberland River where it meets the sea, about 7 km south-west of Lorne, on a coastal Crown reserve. Unpowered garden and riverfront camp sites for tents, plus cabins; book ahead. No pets and no powered sites.

n8285387776.dogs: yes (on leash in camping areas, tied up at night)
n8285387776.source_note: GWMWater Rocklands Reservoir page: camping is in the neighbouring State forest along the foreshore (campgrounds managed by DEECA); dogs must be under control, tied up at night and on a leash in picnic and camping areas; dogs must not enter the water (except duck season). Location on Rocklands Reservoir land per DataVic PLM25; nearest DataVic camp is Fergusons Campsite (1.3 km). Camping details for the DEECA foreshore camps are on forestsandreserves (browser-only).
n8285387776.description: Rom's Bog: camping spot on the shore of Rocklands Reservoir, west of the Grampians. Rocklands camping is in the State forest campgrounds beside the water (DEECA). Dogs on a leash in camping areas and tied up at night.

n1808391681.operator: Balnarring Beach Foreshore and Parks Reserve Committee of Management
n1808391681.source_note: Committee site: three campgrounds (A, B and C Reserves), powered and non-powered sites, each with an amenity block (toilets, showers, camp kitchen, laundry) and free BBQs; no pets or fires; bookings taken from 1 June each season; A Reserve open 1 Sep to King's Birthday weekend, B Reserve Cup Day weekend to Easter and King's Birthday weekend to 1 Sep, C Reserve 26 Dec to 26 Jan and some long weekends. Committee appointed by the Minister (DEECA).
n1808391681.description: Foreshore camping at Balnarring Beach on Western Port, run by the reserve's committee of management: three campgrounds with powered and unpowered sites, each with toilets, showers, camp kitchen and laundry. Paid; book ahead, especially for holidays. No pets and no fires. The three areas open at different times of year.

w1323573174.operator: Lang Lang Foreshore Reserve Committee of Management
w1323573174.dogs: yes (on leash at campsites; not in cabins)
w1323573174.source_note: Lang Lang Foreshore Caravan Park own site (Jam Jerrup): powered and non-powered sites incl. walk-in tent sites, extra-large rig sites, waterfront and self-contained sites, six cabins; book online; pets welcome at campsites on leash, not in cabins. Committee page: DEECA-appointed volunteer committee of management runs the reserve. DataVic PLM25: Western Port Coastal Reserve (COM).
w1323573174.description: Lang Lang Foreshore Caravan Park at Jam Jerrup on Western Port, run by the foreshore committee: powered and unpowered sites from walk-in tent sites to big-rig sites, next to the boat ramp and jetty. Paid; book ahead. Dogs on a leash at campsites.

w354236037.operator: Walkerville Foreshore Reserve Committee of Management
w354236037.source_note: Committee site: Walkerville Foreshore Camping Reserve, 128 powered and unpowered sites for tents, caravans and campervans, two bungalows; book online; summer fire ban (no camp fires); dogs not permitted in the camping reserve except to transit on the marked path.
w354236037.description: Walkerville Foreshore Camping Reserve on Waratah Bay, run by the foreshore committee: 128 powered and unpowered sites along 1 km of beachfront, for tents, caravans and campervans. Paid; book ahead online. No dogs in the camping reserve.

n1808391836.source_note: Glenelg Shire Caravan and Camping guide 2018 (Visit Portland, council tourism): "Fitzroy River Outlet" on Thompson's Road, Tyrendarra East; camp sites on the river bank in coastal scrub; suits all types of camping incl. large motorhomes and caravans; fees apply, collected daily on site; short walk to the beach. Guide is from 2018, so needs review. DataVic PLM25: Yambuk Coastal Reserve (committee of management).
n1808391836.description: Riverbank camping beside the Fitzroy River outlet on Thompson's Road, Tyrendarra East, a short walk from the beach. Suits tents, caravans and big motorhomes. A small fee is collected on site (council guide from 2018, so check current details).

n1808391881.source_note: Glenelg Shire Caravan and Camping guide 2018: "Hotspur, Smokey Crawford River" on the Portland-Casterton Road, large grassy area, limited shade, fishing. Crown frontage (DEECA per PLM25) - other details browser-only.
n1808391881.description: Grassy riverside camping area beside the Crawford River at Hotspur, on the Portland-Casterton Road; limited shade, good for fishing (council guide, 2018).

n1808392073.source_note: Matched to PV "Psyche Bend Camping Area 1 (Kings Billabong Park)" (PV coordinates 120 m away); PV site page: dogs allowed on a leash. PV Murray reach page (SA border to Piangil): all riverside campsites free, no bookings; dispersed camping permitted at Kings Billabong. Kings Billabong park note (PV, via Visit Mildura): camping is dispersed; an area just downstream of Psyche Pumps caters for caravans and campervans; no camping around the Psyche Pump Station itself. PV lists Psyche Bend Camping Area 2 as closed. needs_review because DataVic PLM25 puts the OSM point inside the Psyche Bend Pumps Historic Reserve, near the no-camping zone around the pump station.
n1808392073.description: Psyche Bend camping area in Kings Billabong Park on the Murray, about 8 km south-east of Mildura: dispersed riverside camping, with an area just downstream of Psyche Pumps that suits caravans and campervans. Free, no bookings. Dogs on a leash. No camping right at the Psyche Pump Station.

w1363540100.operator: Lake Boga Caravan Park (Swan Hill Rural City Council lease)
w1363540100.dogs: yes (pet friendly on sites, per the park)
w1363540100.source_note: Swan Hill Rural City Council release (reprinted by Mirage News): Areas 4 and 5 on the north-eastern shore of Lake Boga are Crown land leased to the Lake Boga Caravan Park operator and run as part of the caravan park; council has resolved to consider closing them, subject to negotiation with the lessee. OSM site numbers suggest this is Area 4. Caravan park site: dog friendly sites. Facilities/fees for Areas 4 and 5 are not listed separately.
w1363540100.description: Lakeside camping area (Area 4) on the north-eastern shore of Lake Boga, run as part of the council-leased Lake Boga Caravan Park. Contact the park to book. Swan Hill council is considering closing Areas 4 and 5, so check before you go.

w1363540105.description: Lakeside camping area (Area 5) on the north-eastern shore of Lake Boga, run as part of the council-leased Lake Boga Caravan Park. Contact the park to book. Swan Hill council is considering closing Areas 4 and 5, so check before you go.

n1808391819.source_note: Visit West Wimmera (council tourism): Edenhope Lakeside Tourist Park on Lake Street, on Lake Wallace: cabins, powered caravan and camping sites, tent sites; new amenities block with toilets, camp kitchen, laundry; pet-friendly. West Wimmera council news (Aug 2024): park extended with state funding. DataVic PLM25: point is in Lake Wallace Reserve (council committee of management); whether council runs or leases the park is not stated. Matched by street and reserve; OSM name is "Edenhope Lake Wallace Recreation Ground" - check it is the tourist park.
n1808391819.description: Camping on the shore of Lake Wallace in Edenhope through Edenhope Lakeside Tourist Park: powered and tent sites, cabins, a new amenities block with toilets, camp kitchen and laundry. Pet friendly. Walking and bike track around the lake.

n1808393381.source_note: DataVic PLM25: point is inside "Gordon Park (Charlton Caravan Park)" reserve, council committee of management. Visit Buloke (council tourism): Charlton Caravan Park on the Avoca River; north side has grassed powered and non-powered sites, camp kitchen, laundry, toilets and showers; south side ensuites, cabins and an RV park; pet friendly. OSM tags shower=no conflict with the park listing - check.
n1808393381.description: Gordon Park on the Avoca River in Charlton, home of the Charlton Caravan Park: grassed powered and unpowered sites, camp kitchen, laundry and toilets, an RV area, close to the main street. Pet friendly. Contact the park to book.

w1240332843.source_note: Location inside Mitchell River NP per DataVic PLM25. PV Mitchell River camping page: dogs and other pets are not permitted in the park; camp at least 20 m from water; take all rubbish home. This site is not named on the PV pages.

n4756284375.source_note: Location inside Mitchell River NP per DataVic PLM25. PV Mitchell River camping page: dogs and other pets are not permitted in the park; camp at least 20 m from water; take all rubbish home. This site is not named on the PV pages.
